definitions.explanation: Foam or bubbles that form on the surface of a liquid.
Something that vanishes quickly like a bubble, used figuratively to describe transient or short-lived things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{泡沫|ほうまつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{泡沫|ほうまつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かんでいた→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: White foam was floating on the surface of the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泡沫|ほうまつ}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{儚|はかな}く→儚い：07898_hakanai⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: His success was as ephemeral as foam and was quickly forgotten.

notes:
Can be read as ほうまつ or うたかた, with うたかた being more literary and poetic. The word evokes imagery of bubbles rising and bursting, which is a classic metaphor for impermanence in Japanese literature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泡沫|ほうまつ}⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧: minor candidate, fringe candidate
- {泡沫|ほうまつ}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: fly-by-night company
- {泡沫|ほうまつ}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: to vanish like foam
- {泡沫|ほうまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧: a fleeting dream

CULTURAL NOTE:
The famous opening of {鴨長明|かものちょうめい}'s {方丈記|ほうじょうき} uses the image of foam on water (⟦{水|みず}の{泡|あわ}→水の泡：27216_mizunoawa⟧) to express the Buddhist concept of impermanence (⟦{無常|むじょう}→無常：13422_mujou⟧). The figurative sense of {泡沫|ほうまつ} draws on this literary tradition.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧: bubble, foam — the everyday word for physical bubbles
- ⟦{儚|はかな}い→儚い：07898_hakanai⟧: ephemeral, transient — an adjective expressing the same fleeting quality
